headers.comment: connect-src is open to https/wss because the dashboard's API endpoint is configured at runtime — it cannot be a fixed allowlist. localhost is permitted so the same page can drive an engine running on your machine. Everything else stays default-deny.
headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src https: wss: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* ws://localhost:* ws://127.0.0.1:*; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
